description.content: This function allows you to share your event with others – for example via email or social media. A special link is generated that you can send to friends, family, or guests. With this link, they can view key details about the event and participate.

disclaimer.title: Privacy Notice
disclaimer.content:
When you share your event, some information such as the title and location will be visible to anyone with the link. However, the link includes a randomly generated code, making it very difficult to guess. Only people you share the link with can access the event page.
You can deactivate sharing at any time. Once deactivated, the link will no longer work and the event will no longer be accessible.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.description: This short tour shows you the most important features. You can restart it anytime via the help button in the top right corner.

navDiscover.title: Discover
navDiscover.description: Here you find all published events and can discover new offers.

navSaved.title: Saved
navSaved.description: Events you bookmarked can always be found here.

navRegs.title: My registrations
navRegs.description: Here you see all events you registered for.

navOwn.title: My offers
navOwn.description: Here you manage your own events and can create new ones.

search.title: Search events
search.description: Enter a search term to find events by title or content.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Narrow down the results by category, audience, date range or availability.

layout.title: Switch view
layout.description: Switch between card, list, calendar and map view — whatever suits you best.

filterReset.title: Reset filters
filterReset.description: One click removes all active filters and shows all events again.

details.title: View details
details.description: Click on an event to see all details and register.

create.title: Create a new event
create.description: Here you create your own event and can publish it afterwards.

welcome.title: Your saved events
welcome.description: Here you collect events you are interested in. Tap the bookmark icon on an event in “Discover” to add it to your list.

search.title: Search saved events
search.description: Use the full-text search to quickly find a saved event.

card.title: Saved event
card.description: Each entry shows date, time, location, categories and audiences at a glance. If you are already registered, the status of your registration is shown as well.

details.title: View details
details.description: Opens the event detail page — there you find all information and can register directly.

remove.title: Remove from saved
remove.description: Removes the event from your saved list — you can of course still find it under “Discover”.

welcome.title: My registrations
welcome.description: Here you see all events you registered for — including the current status of your registration.

search.title: Search registrations
search.description: Use the full-text search to quickly find a specific registration.

card.title: Your registration
card.description: The entry shows the status of your registration. Click it to see details or manage your registration.

welcome.title: My offers
welcome.description: Here you manage your own events — from creation and publishing to managing participants.

search.title: Search offers
search.description: Use the full-text search to quickly find your events.

create.title: Create a new event
create.description: Create a new event here and publish it once everything is ready.

card.title: Your offer
card.description: Each card shows your event with all important information — much of it can be edited right here without leaving the page.

chips.title: Categories & audiences
chips.description: Click the category or audience chips to adjust them directly — changes are saved immediately.

text.title: Edit texts
text.description: Use the pencil to quickly adjust the title and short description of your event.

stats.title: Registrations at a glance
stats.description: Here you see how many spots are taken and free — and whether there is a waiting list.

manage.title: Manage
manage.description: Opens the management page of your event: there you see all registrations, accept or decline participants, manage the waiting list and export the guest list.

edit.title: Edit
edit.description: Opens the edit dialog where you adjust all key data — for example date, location and participant limit.

message.title: Message
message.description: Sends a message to all registered participants — useful for last-minute changes or important information.

promote.title: Promote
promote.description: Share your event via link or QR code to reach more participants. The button becomes active once you enable sharing in the event settings.

cancel.title: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancels the event — all registered participants will be informed.

welcome.title: Your user profile
welcome.description: Here you manage your personal data and settings.

profile.title: Personal data
profile.description: Here you see your stored data such as name, email, phone number and language.

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.description: Use the pencil to edit your data — for example contact information or your preferred language.

preferences.title: Settings
preferences.description: Subscribe to or unsubscribe from the newsletter here — it keeps you informed about new events.

welcome.title: Your addresses
welcome.description: Here you manage your saved addresses. When creating an event you can select one of them as the venue.

add.title: Add a new address
add.description: Create a new address with street, zip code and city.

import.title: Import addresses
import.description: Take over existing addresses from your account instead of entering them again.

card.title: Your address
card.description: Each card shows one saved address with all its details.

default.title: Default address
default.description: Mark an address as default — it will then be preselected automatically.

actions.title: Edit & delete
actions.description: Use the pencil to change the address, the trash can to remove it.

welcome.title: Event details
welcome.description: On this page you find all information about an event — and can register directly.

info.title: All info at a glance
info.description: Description, date and all important facts about the event.

host.title: Host
host.description: Here you see who offers the event.

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: Register for the event here, see free spots and the status of your registration — and cancel it if needed.

location.title: Venue
location.description: The address of the event with a map — so you find your way there.

bookmark.title: Save for later
bookmark.description: Tap the heart to add the event to your saved list — so you can quickly find it again later.

share.title: Share
share.description: Share the event with friends via link.

guests.title: Guest list
guests.description: As the host you see all registrations here and manage your guests.

shareSettings.title: Enable sharing
shareSettings.description: Enable sharing of your event here — only then can you promote it publicly.

edit.title: Edit
edit.description: As the host you edit your event here.
